issues.quote: زبان الزام فقط در بندهای ۲، ۵.۱، ۶.۱ و ۶.۲ است.
issues.explanation: The word «فقط» (only) turns this into an unqualified negative claim about every other clause in the standard — asserting that no shall-level language appears anywhere outside these four clauses. Per the review criteria, absence claims are supported only when explicitly limited to the clauses actually cited. The evidence confirms [shall] tags in clauses 2, 5.1, 6.1, and 6.2 (S23684-014, S23684-021, S23684-056, S23684-059), but the supplied evidence does not provide full normative coverage of the standard, so the absolute «فقط» overreaches what can be verified.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «فقط در بندهای ۲، ۵.۱، ۶.۱ و ۶.۲ است» with «در بندهای بررسی‌شده (۲، ۵.۱، ۶.۱ و ۶.۲) مشاهده شد» or add a qualifier such as «بر اساس مستندات موجود».
